description: For Wikipedia and Wikidata editors: checks two facts about every Chilean comuna in Spanish and English Wikipedia and in Wikidata against their systems of record, its population against INE's official figures and its mayor against SERVEL's election results, explains why each one differs, and drafts sourced corrections for a person to review and apply.
license: Apache-2.0 (code); data files keep their own licences (see README)

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Reads the source catalog in Zetaris, resolves the scope, plans the default sources; on discovery chooses which catalog sources to add for the figures the Critic sends back
agents.model: chooses a source per figure, with a reason

agents.name: Retriever
agents.role: Runs one SQL statement per source against the Zetaris views and writes each row into the World Model with provenance

agents.name: Extractor
agents.role: Reads infobox references, population tables and the sentences that state a population; keeps a claim only if its figure and year are verbatim in the sentence and the sentence in the article

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Matches every claim against every official figure read and classifies why it differs (11-class taxonomy)
agents.model: classifies the claims the matcher can't settle

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Scores each finding on a 9-point rubric, recomputing the facts; rejects and sends one fix to the Planner, Extractor or Analyst; holds up comunas with claims nothing read can check; reviews every draft

agents.name: Editor
agents.role: Builds wikitext, citations and QuickStatements from templates; drafts only, never edits
agents.model: writes edit summaries and the reviewer's explanation

loops: Critic rounds (max 2 fixes per comuna; 3 for mayors, one election further back each)

zetaris.role: The data layer: every source the agents compare is a view in the factsync container, virtualised from public APIs (INE ArcGIS, Wikidata SPARQL, MediaWiki) and INE files in the Zetaris file store
zetaris.source_catalog: factsync.source_catalog lists every source, the fact it is about, its definition, scope and years; the Planner reads it at plan time and chooses from it on discovery

usl.name: lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_population
usl.data_quality: key and foreign-key constraints, plus registered rules cut_is_code, population_positive and figure_is_a_number

usl_mayors.name: lightning.metastore.factsync.comuna_mayor
usl_mayors.data_quality: key and foreign-key constraints, plus registered rules comuna_code_5_digits, votes_not_negative, elected_is_flag and mayor_named

zetaris.app_user: a General-role (read-only) user with SELECT on the factsync views only (zetaris/05_readonly_grants.sql, checked by scripts/verify_readonly.py)

meterless.feature: The agents' shared state: comunas keyed by INE code, every source row and extracted claim as a provenance-stamped observation, append-only assessments by agent and round, budgeted context payloads, the comuna picture as a registered projection, and point-in-time reconstruction to show what changed since the last check
meterless.conformance: the 8 checks of the official suite (sid-001, sid-002, band-001, prov-001, idem-001, idem-002, bitemp-001, audit-001), ported one-to-one
meterless.capabilities_report: result.json world_model.capabilities lists the capabilities each run used and the dormant ones

nightshift.role: primary AI provider: every model call goes through Meterless Nightshift's OpenAI-compatible API
nightshift.evidence: each model call's trace event records the model requested, the model Nightshift says served it, the receipt's routed model and the receipt id

nvidia.via: Meterless Nightshift (the NVIDIA key lives only in Nightshift)
